title: DeltaBox: Millisecond-Scale Sandbox Checkpoint and Rollback for Stateful AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.22781v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Emerging LLM-powered AI agent workloads, such as test-time tree search and reinforcement learning (RL), require high-frequency state exploration, relying on rapid checkpoint/restore (C/R) of the complete sandbox state, including files and process state. Existing mechanisms duplicate the entire state, causing hundreds of milliseconds to seconds of latency per C/R, which severely bottlenecks deep search and large-scale fan-outs. We observe that consecutive sandbox states between checkpoints differ only marginally. Therefore, instead of full duplication, a sandbox should only duplicate the changes between consecutive checkpoints (Key Insight), yet the lack of OS support makes this hard to realize. We propose a new OS-level abstraction, DeltaState, that delivers change-based C/R for agents through co-designed OS mechanisms. translated_title: DeltaBox：面向有状态AI智能体的毫秒级沙盒检查点与回滚
translated_abstract: 新兴的基于大语言模型（LLM）驱动的AI智能体工作负载，如测试时树搜索和强化学习（RL），需要进行高频的状态探索，这依赖于对完整沙盒状态（包括文件和进程状态）的快速检查点/恢复（C/R）。现有机制会完整复制整个状态，导致每次C/R产生数百毫秒到数秒的延迟，严重制约了深度搜索和大规模扇出操作。我们观察到，检查点之间相邻的沙盒状态仅有微小差异。因此，沙盒不应进行全量复制，而应只复制连续检查点之间的变更（关键洞察），然而操作系统的支持缺失使这一想法难以实现。我们提出了一种新的操作系统级抽象DeltaState，通过协同设计的操作系统机制为智能体提供基于变更的C/R。首先，DeltaFS通过冻结当前可写层并插入新的可写层来对文件状态进行检查点操作，从而将文件更新……
tldr: 提出DeltaBox系统，基于“相邻沙盒状态间差异微小”这一关键洞察，设计操作系统级抽象DeltaState，通过仅复制增量变更而非全量状态，实现了毫秒级的沙盒检查点与回滚，支撑AI智能体的高频状态探索。
en_tdlr: DeltaBox introduces DeltaState, an OS-level abstraction that enables millisecond-scale, delta-based sandbox checkpoint and rollback for stateful AI agents by copying only the marginal changes between consecutive sandbox states instead of duplicating the full state.
